Name: Deep Pause Guardian
Information:
**Deep Pause Guardian**

The Deep Pause Guardian is an artificial protector of the eponymous temple it’s named after. It is animated by ancient druidic rituals that form stone and wood into a protector, which has been adapted to be particularly efficient at staving off the forces of the First to Consume. These Guardians appear as giant fox statues, which breathe and manifest a ghostly blue flame that burns the soul. Those affiliated with Kitsune and the Deep Pause will often have one assigned to them as a watcher.

**Prophetbound**

Due to their connection to the Deep Pause, if Elstrakin is ever killed then these Guardians will cease functioning - unless another force (such as Kitsune or Luxus) assumes control of them. In these cases, those beyond the influence of the Deep Pause Temple will become inert, resembling statues.

**The Tailmother’s Eyes**

Agents selected by Elstrakin are accompanied by a Guardian in their duties commonly, but oftentimes not for the purposes of combat: these sentinels can be used to remotely speak with Elstrakin, who can see, hear, and speak through them like distant familiars. Elstrakin does not part with them easily, so only those she is fond of find themselves in one’s company. In truly rare cases, she may allow other archdruids and servants to bond to one the way she does, allowing them to use it for remote communication with others as well.

Stat Blocks.title: Deep Pause Guardian
languages: understands Common, Elvish, and Kitzish, but doesn’t speak

traits.name: Death Ravager
traits.description: The construct has advantage on attack rolls against fiends and undead. When it reduces an undead to 0 hit points, the undead has disadvantage on saving throws made for Undead Fortitude, or other abilities that help it to prevent death.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.description: The construct attacks once with its Bite, and twice with its Stone Strike.

actions.name: Bite
actions.description: Melee Weapon Attack: +9 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 14 (2d8 + 5) piercing damage plus 7 (2d6) fire damage.

actions.name: Stone Strike
actions.description: Melee Weapon Attack: +9 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 16 (2d10 + 5) bludgeoning damage. If the target is Medium or smaller, it must make a DC 17 Strength saving throw, and is knocked prone on a failure. A target must only make this save once per turn.

actions.name: Circle of Ghost Flame (Recharge 6)
actions.description: The construct creates a swirling ring of blue flame that ignores plants, wood, and non-living materials (except Constructs), but otherwise envelopes each other creature within 30 feet. Each target must make a DC 16 Dexterity saving throw, taking 28 (5d10) fire damage and 28 (5d10) radiant damage on a failure, or half as much on a success. Undead creatures have disadvantage on their saving throws against Circle of Ghost Flame.
